question: How many days of annual leave does a full-time employee receive?
answer: Full-time employees receive 25 days of annual leave each year.
contexts: Annual leave policy: Full-time employees are entitled to 25 days of paid annual leave per calendar year. Leave must be approved by a line manager.
Sick leave is separate from annual leave and is capped at 10 paid days per year.
